_comment: Per-model parameter constraints for Human-in-the-Loop tool-call editing. Keyed by tool name, then by model. 'modelId' is the cfgpu-internal model id and stays the operational key (model_tool_configs.model_id); 'modelName' is the cfgpu MCP's public model identifier — the value the MCP's 'model' tool parameter now accepts (its enum lists model_name only; adapterId / cfgpu_model_id are never exposed). The two differ for the dated/renamed models (e.g. modelId doubao-seedance-2-0-260128 -> modelName doubao-seedance-2-0, nano-pro -> cf-pro), so a caller building a generate_* tool call must send modelName, not modelId. The per-entry args.model options/value carry modelName values accordingly — that field is what actually goes on the wire, so it must match the MCP enum, whereas modelId is only a DB key. 'args' maps the unified (generic) arg names from tool_registry.py to the REAL value range/type of the underlying model (extracted from each model's card.md/adapter.yaml). Params a model does NOT support are omitted from that model's entry. quality_tier drives model='auto' routing, so it is listed on the 'auto' entry; it ALSO appears on the per-model entries whose adapter maps it into the payload (kling-video-o1 / kling-v3-omni -> mode, gpt-image-2 -> quality), where it stays meaningful after the model is fixed. Models whose entry omits it ignore it once selected. writable=false means the field is fixed/control-only and should not be exposed for editing. model_specific is a free-form passthrough dict (passthrough=true): its 'fields' map lists the documented per-model sub-keys with their ranges; users may still pass additional undocumented keys.

Flat snake_case request: prompt / aspect_ratio / video_length (STRING seconds) / resolution_name (lowercase tier) / refer_images[]. first_frame and reference_images share the single refer_images array (first_frame listed first). Does not use last_frame / reference_videos / reference_audios / with_audio / watermark / quality_tier. Billed per second in two tiers (<=480P 0.275, >480P 0.385 元/秒); cheaper than cf-imagine-video-1.5, same request shape.
